events.descripcion: The Heavenly Tower contains 50 stages, called Floors (階 Kai), with a wide variety of enemies including Cyclones, Enemy Cats, Advent Bosses and even event enemies from monthly and annual events. After completing a floor for the first time, the player will receive gifts including Battle Items, Catseyes, Catfruit, Tickets, Catamins, XP, Materials and Leaderships along with Hermit Cat, Masked Yulala and Master Uril upon defeating their respective counterparts on the 30th, 40th and 50th floors respectively, via the Catnip Challenges feature.

Legend Quest is a map somewhat similar to Heavenly Tower, with 48 stages known as LEVELs. Each LEVEL is a random Stories of Legend stage that provides a partially randomized lineup. All LEVELs are No Continues, and exiting a battle within 10 seconds will not refund items, Crowns or energy.

Best of the Best Milestone Edition (DL記念選抜ガチャ, Daunrōdo Kinen Senbatsu Gacha, DL Celebration Selection Gacha) is a Rare Cat Capsule event added in Version 14.6. It features Koneko along with selected Uber Rare units from the regular Rare Cat Capsule events in addition to all of the non-collab Legend Rare units.

This event contains three stages, each stage is a trip to all Growing Stage of the same difficulty labeled on each stage, in sequence: Growing Green, Growing Purple, Growing Red, Growing Blue and finally Growing Yellow, which is ended with the Catfruit Jubilee. After the player clears one Growing Stage, a message will show up to ask if the player wants to continue on the next Growing Stage. The player can play a total of six stages, and it costs 500 energy per play.

Introduced in Version 14.3 adds a new gimmick where applying status effects grant more points than killing enemies. More points will be awarded for units with fewer target Traits (not counting those gained from Talents). This rewards for this dojo are Treasure Chests, which contain exclusive Talent Orbs that can grant special abilities to the units that are given them.
It's high noon, time for a showdown!

Are your Cats a match for these mighty fighters?
The Street Fighter x The Battle Cats collab event is on,
January 9 (11:00AM) through January 26, 2026 (10:59AM)

・New units in two Collab Capsule Sets!
Aiming to be the best in the world, the fighters have arrived!
New Uber Rare units Juri (BLUE TEAM) and Cammy (RED TEAM) have been added along with Super Rare units Zangief Cat and Jamie Cat!
Tap the banner in the Rare Capsules to see the character lineup and their abilities!

※ The units shown above will be available only during this event. Please be aware that there is a chance that you may also collect non-collab characters from collab event banners.
※ The units shown above will be available only from the collab banners at the Rare Capsules. Tap the banner at the top of the screen to switch between BLUE TEAM and RED TEAM capsules sets.

・Collab Stages in The Battle Cats!
Battle the world's strongest fighters in limited collab stages!
Street Fighter characters appear as enemies!
Also, all stages have had their clear rewards reset!
Visit the Legend Stages/Event Stages during this collab event to test your Cats at Street Fighter collab maps!

・Collab Stage "Street Fighter"
Travel the world in search of the strongest fighters! There are three difficulty levels to challenge: EASY, NORMAL, and HARD!

Clear these collab stages for a chance to earn Ryu Cat, only available to collect during this event!
Get a higher chance of earning Ryu Cat from later stages!

Also, stage rewards have been reset!
Stage rewards are available to collect once again for anyone that has cleared these stages in a previous collab event!

※ Tap the Timed Score button at the bottom left of the Map menu to check available rewards.
※ Ryu Cat can be unlocked from the Rare Unit section of the Upgrade menu.
※ Use a Treasure Radar for a guaranteed chance to earn Ryu Cat as a drop reward upon Victory.
※ You cannot collect Ryu Cat as a reward again if already earned from a previous event.

・Collab Stage "New Challenger"
New challengers have arrived!
Visit the Stories of Legend/Event Stages at the times below during this collab event to test your Cats at the New Challenger collab map! New stages featuring Juri and Cammy have been added!

12:00AM - 1:59AM, 3:00AM - 4:59AM, 6:00AM - 7:59AM, 9:00AM - 10:59AM, 12:00PM - 1:59PM, 3:00PM - 4:59PM, 6:00PM - 7:59PM, 9:00PM - 10:59PM

The fighters shown below will appear randomly on the following days:
Monday: Ryu, Blanka, Balrog, Cammy
Tuesday: Chun-Li, Dhalsim, Vega, Juri
Wednesday: Guile, Ken, Sagat, Sakura
Thursday: Zangief, E. Honda, M. Bison, Luke
Friday, Saturday, and Sunday feature ALL fighters, and with two stage difficulty levels each!

Defeat 4 fighters on any difficulty to face a new, stronger challenger!
Defeat this mysterious and powerful challenger for a chance to earn a limited unit!

※ Check the Event Calendar in the Cat Base to see the dates each stage will appear on.
※ Use a Treasure Radar for a guaranteed chance to earn drop rewards upon Victory.

・Collab Stage "Street Fighter - VERY HARD -"
Street Fighter - VERY HARD - can be challenged after clearing a certain stage!
Stand your ground and face down the strongest challengers!

・The "I Seek the Strongest" map is available in the Arena of Honor at the Catclaw Dojo!
Who is the strongest fighter on Earth?!
Test your skill against Street Fighter collab characters in collab-limited event stages!

Visit the Catclaw Dojo during this collab event to put your Cats to the test in the "I Seek the Strongest" map!

Climb to the highest tiers of power as your scores are measured against all other Battle Cats players! Can you make it to the top 10%?
Try as many times as you like before the event ends, and earn special rewards when your final high score determines your skill tier.
Tap the Rewards List button to see what you might win as you climb the rankings!
Take on the onslaught of fighters and aim for a high ranking!

※ Rewards may take a short time to be delivered after your final ranking tier is determined. Thanks for your patience!
※ Your Ranking Result will be shown in the Catclaw Dojo, but rewards will be claimed by visiting the Mailbox menu from the Battle Cats title screen.
※ Rewards will expire and become unclaimable 30 days after delivery.
※ Network connection is required to play the Arena of Honor. Your score and ranking will be reset when the event ends.
※ Accounts flagged for hacking or modding will have their Arena scores invalidated and may receive a playing ban.
※ Empire of Cats Ch. 1 must be cleared before the Catclaw Dojo will be available to access.

・Collab-limited Missions and Log-in Stamps available!
Street Fighter 6 Collab Special Missions have been added to the Catnip Challenges!
Clear limited Special missions to earn Cat Tickets!
Limited log-in stamps are available during the collab event!
Log in during the collab event to earn one stamp each day!
Log in for 5 days to earn collab-limited Special unit Chun-Li Cat!
Don't forget to log in each day to collect other useful item rewards!

※ Limited-time Special Missions will only appear in the Catnip Challenges until the end of the event. You must accept all rewards before the mission disappears at the end of the Catnip Challenges event!
※Once you have unlocked Chun-Li Cat, activate her by visiting the Special Cats section of the Upgrade menu.
※If you have earned Chun-Li Cat from a previous event, you will not be able to unlock her again.
※ There are 17 log-in stamps for this event.
